decisions.reason: This flexible spotlight line is close to the core offer and has its own web page, which signals active promotion, so with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall against aspiration that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.
The multi-outlet canopy is a low-cost accessory that builds on the modular system and supports sales of luminaires, so carrying it uses little slack and fits the flexible-systems strategy.
The low-voltage canopy complements the established low-voltage and track offer at minimal cost, and its own presentation page suggests it is meeting the firm's expectations.

The glass track line is only mentioned rather than featured, which points to weaker visibility, but it is a young line close to the core with uncertain results, so the firm's slack lets it carry the line for another year before judging it against aspirations.
